basis.name: native-qualification-cut400-l29
basis.source: SEP 12 native qualification: custom E_cut=400 hartree, lmax=29; remaining radial/ECS/potential fields unchanged from basis 2b086180abfc614b55fd1251e5dd1caf3fa2c88de7e4bb86ba673b8af9e75a0a; provider 3e99e319ff48024b35083f262dfdab7c36871388

limitations: Scale1.537 multiplies j_total-j1; coherent-current calibration does not establish ionisation scaling, an electron count or physical1%accuracy.
The combined basis/step/sampling configuration and finite physical window require the declared followup checks; radial lattice and ECS remain fixed and unqualified.
120--200nm is a numerical reporting band, not a validated material domain.

Explicit gated_derivative (SEP 26) applies the grid collar to the subtracted native current and subtracts the collar's edge term, holding the current after the collar instead of switching it off; raw drive and histories remain unchanged. The new form was propagated on the 60 fs window segment only; on this full-lattice collar its edge term is 0.07% of the band source, evaluated offline per call.

Requested 60 fs finite history does not pass a 1 percent full-band source screen: the 60 fs window differs from 120 and 240 fs windows by about 8.7-8.8% under either filter. The edge-free form reduces the source-filter width sensitivity 3 to 1000 times; this remains an economical research approximation.

Empirical scale1.537 from native weak-current evidence.
